{
  "implementation": "import heapq
import collections

def solve(case):
    nodes_list = case['payload']['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['payload']['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {}
    children = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for n in nodes_list:
        nid = n['id']
        node_map[nid] = n
        parent = n.get('parent')
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].add(nid)
    root_id = next(nid for nid, n in node_map.items() if n['parent'] is None)
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    symbol_count = collections.Counter()
    for n in node_map.values():
        symbol_count[n['symbol']] += 1
    removal_order = []
    # initial candidates: removable, not root, not required symbol, no retained children
    heap = []
    for nid, n in node_map.items():
        if (n['removable'] and
            nid != root_id and
            n['symbol'] not in required_symbols and
            not any(c in retained for c in children[nid])):
            heapq.heappush(heap, (-n['depth'], nid, nid))  # depth desc, id asc
    while heap:
        neg_depth, tid, nid = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        n = node_map[nid]
        # recheck conditions (might have changed)
        if (not n['removable'] or
            nid == root_id or
            n['symbol'] in required_symbols or
            any(c in retained for c in children[nid])):
            continue
        # check required symbols remain
        sym = n['symbol']
        if (symbol_count[sym] == 1 and sym in required_symbols):
            continue
        # proceed to remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        symbol_count[sym] -= 1
        if symbol_count[sym] == 0:
            del symbol_count[sym]
        removal_order.append(nid)
        # check parent
        pid = n.get('parent')
        if pid is not None and pid in retained:
            p = node_map[pid]
            if (p['removable'] and
                pid != root_id and
                p['symbol'] not in required_symbols and
                not any(c in retained for c in children[pid])):
                heapq.heappush(heap, (-p['depth'], pid, pid))
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"retained": retained_sorted, "removal_order": removal_order}
"
}
